name: Lan Fa Textile Co.,Ltd.
summary: Lan Fa Textile Co.,Ltd. specializes in the production and supply of a diverse range of polyester yarns and fibers. The company's offerings include standard polyester yarns available in various finishes, such as matte, semi-lustrous, and glossy options. It also manufactures superfine fibers, specifically engineered for the creation of synthetic buckskin or suede-like textiles. Additionally, Lan Fa provides composite fibers, including its CD series, contracted yarns, and thick-and-thin yarns. These versatile materials are widely adopted in apparel manufacturing for items like skirts, trousers, suits, and outerwear, as well as in tatting, knitting, imitation suedes, jackets, and multi-colored yarn applications. A significant part of its product line comprises advanced functional fibers designed for specific performance benefits. These include moisture-wicking and quick-drying yarns, which are perfect for activewear (such as sports and golf attire), intimate apparel (like underwear and bras), shirt jackets, hats, socks, gloves, kneecaps, waist supports, and various woven or knitted fabrics. Other specialized fibers include hollow-core yarns for enhanced thermal insulation in winter clothing, insulated jackets, and sportswear; UV-resistant yarns for sun-protective textiles; and flame-retardant yarns, crucial for interior home furnishings and automotive upholstery materials. Established in 1972, Lan Fa Textile Co.,Ltd. is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.
